about_the_game:
A Quiet Day is a gentle puzzle game about small moments and calm rituals.

Arrange objects, discover soft connections, and move through puzzles that feel more like pauses than challenges.

There’s no rush, no timers, no pressure to perform... Just simple interactions, warm visuals, and the feeling of a day unfolding quietly.

Some days are loud.
Some days demand too much.

A Quiet Day is about the moments in between.

The small rituals we hold onto; a warm drink, a familiar object, a half-finished note on the table.
The way time slows when nothing urgent is asking for us.

This is a gentle puzzle game about arranging thoughts, objects, and moments.
There is no rush. No pressure to win.
Only simple interactions, soft logic, and the quiet satisfaction of things falling into place.

You don’t fix the world here.
You just give yourself a moment inside it.

What You Will Play

  • Tidy, match, sort, order and connect little objects in relaxing puzzle scenes

  • Enjoy calm gameplay with no timers, pressure, or stress - just peaceful flow

  • Watch the day unfold through cozy environments from morning to night

  • Discover subtle stories told through wholesome, atmospheric levels

  • Unwind with soft music, ambient sounds, and warm colors designed for mindfulness

☕ In A Quiet Day, you spend a slow, gentle day solving small puzzles inspired by calm rituals and everyday moments. Rearrange, organize, and piece together a peaceful world — one soothing scene at a time.

Key Features

  • A short, heart-warming casual puzzle experience for cozy-game lovers

  • Wholesome, calming atmosphere

  • Inspired by calm moments and creative play - perfect for a quiet break

  • Ideal for fans of A Little to the Left, Unpacking, Botany Manor, and Tiny Room Stories

A Quiet Day began as a small experiment to slow down — a way to turn peaceful daily moments into interactive memories.

We believe even simple, everyday actions can feel magical when seen through a lens of presence.

Hope you enjoy your ride and join us in celebrating puzzles telling stories.

Follow for our updates on A Quiet Day, and other upcoming Pocket Bat titles.
